The '''simulator room''' was a room aboard the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] warship [[Independence/Legends|Independence]]. It contained forty-eight [[Flight simulator/Legends|flight simulators]] that could be used by Alliance [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
